# Component parity matrix

<!-- Generated by tools/inventory (npm run all). Do not edit by hand. -->

> Snapshot: livewire `84e8172`, react `5b764e8`, vue `229b7b7`.

81 canonical components come from 202 exports: 85 livewire, 59 react, 58 vue.

| Where it exists | Components |
|---|---|
| All three stacks | 49 |
| Livewire only | 25 |
| React and Vue only | 7 |

React and Vue match each other almost everywhere; the only exports that differ are `File`/`FileUpload` and React-only `StatGroup`. The real gap is Livewire against the other two.

`canonical` names come from the accepted [vocabulary](vocabulary.md). A row existing in all three stacks does not mean equal capability: see the notes, and [api-differences.md](api-differences.md).

## Livewire-only candidates

Input to the parity-target decision (#8).

| Component | Why |
|---|---|
| **Signature** | Named in #8. Canvas-based, so porting is small; the question is demand. |
| **RichTextEditor** | Named in #8. Only the TinyMCE engine is Livewire-only; React and Vue already ship a lighter editor, so this is an engine decision rather than a parity gap. |
| **StreamableContent** | Built on wire:stream. React and Vue would need a different transport. |
| **ImageLibrary** | Named in #8. Tied to Livewire file uploads and the WithMediaSync trait. |
| **ThemePreview** | A theming dev tool rather than a UI component; may move to the docs-site theme builder (open question 5). |

The other Livewire-only components have no platform reason to stay that way, so they need React and Vue ports unless #8 says otherwise: Combobox, Tags, SelectGroup, DateTime, CheckboxGroup, Rating, Fieldset, Form, ValidationSummary, Link, PageHeader, Heading, Text, ListItem, UserMenu, ProgressRadial, KpiCard, ImageGallery, ImageSlider, Kbd, Swap.

## Consolidation candidates

| Component | Proposal |
|---|---|
| **Combobox** | Choices + ChoicesOffline → Combobox with `searchable` and `remote` modes. |
| **Tags** | Candidate to become a Combobox `multiple` + `allowCustom` mode; it already shares the searchable option API. |
| **SelectGroup** | Candidate for Select with an option-group shape rather than a separate component. |
| **DateTime** | Candidate for a DatePicker `time` mode; the issue tracks both together. |
| **RadioGroup** | `radio` and `radio-group` overlap almost entirely (only `inline` vs `horizontal` differ). `group` is the same options API rendered as a joined button group, which becomes a `variant`. |
| **Menu** | Menu* are one family, with composition as the base; see vocabulary.md, 'Data-driven vs compositional'. |
| **Heading** | Subheading → Heading with a `level` or `size`. |
| **UserMenu** | Candidate to become an Avatar + DropdownMenu recipe in the docs rather than a component. |
| **ProgressRadial** | Candidate for Progress with `variant="radial"`. |
| **KpiCard** | Overlaps Stat (`change`, `sparklineData`). Candidate for a Stat `surface`/layout option. |
| **ImageSlider** | Overlaps Carousel. Candidate for a Carousel image mode. |
